title: About
text: My name is Gunnar and I'm a front-end developer from Reykjavík, Iceland. I'm based in Stockholm, where I live with my wife and two kids. My hobbies include football, disc golf and running.
I have been working as a front-end developer for eight years now and I love creating beautiful user interfaces and exploring new technologies.
